lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-lateral flank, extending posteriorly from the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, showing a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a smaller teleost (likely a remora) attached to the ventral surface, posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
